data.bond_enumeration: frozen cache bond_index, one row per physical bond; PyG bidirectional edge storage is not expanded

interpretation.basis: B@1 is zero to machine precision and B@H equals B@H_within to ~1e-15 relative.  The response is nonzero on every audited state.  D1 c_loc keeps response top1=0.631 and response PR=2.441; D1 b and c_glob have higher response PR (20.320 and 5.609).  This is an algebraic response, not evidence of label utility or generalization.
interpretation.label: NONTRIVIAL_BUT_COMPONENT_DEPENDENT_RESPONSE

kernel.definition: B = sym(lazy one-step physical-bond walk) - d d^T/sum(d)
